author: jackrabbit
text:
v0.3.1 P2: harness step record relocation + snapshot simplification

Step records (request.json, response.json, meta.json, tools/<tool-id>/)
move from <worktree>/steps/ to <conv-repo>/steps/, outside every
worktree. Step 1's dispatch commit lands goal.md + soul.md only (no
request.json in the tree); step ≥2 takes no pre-call commit. Per-step
meta.json carries the branch-tip sha captured at step-start so replay
re-runs context assembly against the right tree without reading the
diagnostic request.json.

The amended §2.3 diagnostic-only contract is now structurally enforced:
no harness code path reads request.json or response.json at runtime
(the compactor stub's prior read is dropped — the v0.3 placeholder
summary identifies the parent conversation by id only). Tool
input.json / output.json reads are preserved per §3.3. Frontend reads
under crates/lernie-ui-egui/ are preserved per §2.3 (§3.5 reader path).

Manifest worker.order trims steps/**/request.json and
steps/**/response.json; OverflowPolicy gains DropOldestSummaries.
README updated for the new step-record path; UI fs_watcher and
git_tree retargeting is deferred to P4 (bl-f08f).

Tests, docs, and 100% coverage all green via make ci.
